description: Source code implementing CPU cgroup management functions, including applying resource limits, setting real-time scheduling, and retrieving CPU statistics.

classes.name: CpuGroup
classes.description: Represents a CPU cgroup with methods to apply settings, set resource limits, and retrieve statistics.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the cgroup, which is 'cpu'.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Creates the cgroup directory, sets real-time scheduling, and adds a process to the cgroup.

methods.name: SetRtSched
methods.description: Configures real-time scheduling parameters for the cgroup.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Sets resource limits such as CPU shares, period, quota, burst, and idle time.

methods.name: GetStats
methods.description: Reads CPU throttling statistics from the cgroup's cpu.stat file.
